Use case: stylized-concept with strict real-person facial reference.
Create ONE finished source-art illustration for a LIMITED mercenary character in Soopketmon PROJECT V, working name 나무늘봉순, prospective SS. Render a native 1024x1536 or 2048x3072 RGB PNG, exact 2:3 portrait. One adult woman, not a montage, no frame or text.

REFERENCE ROLES, in order:
1. The provided duo photograph: use ONLY THE WOMAN ON THE LEFT as the primary facial identity anchor for this character. Faithfully translate her recognizable proportions into polished semi-real 2D game painting: soft oval face and cheeks, large clear warm brown eyes with their original spacing and shape, fine natural brows, small softly rounded nose, characteristic full pink-red lips, gentle expression, long dark chestnut hair and a straight wispy fringe. Make her recognizably the LEFT woman rather than a generic anime face. Do NOT mix in the right woman's face. Photo supplies facial identity only, not the red costume, background or letters.
2. Weapon screenshot: primary complete rifle design reference. Preserve the long futuristic assault-rifle silhouette, silver/ivory segmented receiver, coherent charcoal mechanics, restrained champagne-gold armor panels, curved dark magazine, open angular skeleton stock and gold grip details. Make it a clean high-end illustrated weapon with consistent structure and natural hand contact. Remove ALL markings, logos and screenshot UI. No extra weapon.
3. Vespera source art: PRIMARY PAINTING QUALITY AND STYLE ONLY. Inherit beautiful readable face, sophisticated painterly material rendering and coherent fantasy game lighting. Do not copy her face, short hair, red suit, glasses, pose, city or palette.
4. Existing Bongsoon LOTTE avatar: adult figure and long elegant leg proportions ONLY, subordinate to photograph face identity. Do not copy its uniform, heels, crest, harbor setting or pose.

CONCEPT AND COSTUME:
Snowfield elite special-forces woman. Beautiful adult athletic-slender silhouette with naturally long well-shaped legs, balanced torso and hips, elegant realistic shoulders and joints. An opaque fitted ivory-white insulated tactical jacket with a small soft winter collar, fitted sleeves, subtle silver geometric protection at one shoulder and the forearms, charcoal seam details and refined champagne-gold fasteners matching the rifle. A separate high-waisted SHORT ivory tactical MINISKIRT with a crisp upper-thigh hem, restrained asymmetric overlapping panels and fitted waist. The skirt is visibly short; never trousers, shorts, long coat or long skirt. Strong distinct winter silhouette, tasteful opaque tailoring. Long thighs and the leg lines must read clearly; sleek white-and-charcoal fitted calf boots with modest grounded soles, not bulky armor boots. No helmet, mask, goggles, glasses or oversized gloves hiding the face or hands. Avoid huge shoulder armor, cluttered straps and duplicate dangling cloth. Hair flows behind her shoulders in one main direction.

POSE AND SCENE:
She is stepping naturally over a shallow snowy ridge, poised and alert, torso turned slightly, face calmly facing the viewer. Full figure with both boot soles readable, natural long legs, no stretched anatomy or doll head. Rifle held diagonally across lower torso at low ready, stock close to the shoulder/upper arm, right hand physically wrapped around the pistol grip with trigger discipline, left hand underneath the actual fore-end, correct wrists, five fingers per hand. The weapon stays clear of the face and skirt silhouette. No firing, violence, muzzle flash or other characters.
A rich atmospheric snowy high-altitude special-forces outpost, windblown snow, distant icy cliffs, subtle military-fantasy structures and pale overcast light. Ivory, cold slate and restrained gold, luminous soft face fill. The background is deeper and softer than the character, with spatial perspective and controlled snow particles.

FINISH:
High-end character-centered SEMI-REALISTIC FANTASY SPLASH ART, premium Korean collectible 2D game painting matching Vespera's workmanship. Strong facial identity, beautiful expressive eyes, painterly hair, soft illustrated skin, convincing differentiated cloth/leather/metal, polished NOT heavily weathered mechanics. No photorealism, cosplay photo, 3D render, plastic skin, flat cel shading, chibi, giant head or artificial ultra-tiny waist. Use a slightly active full-figure composition with face clearly readable near the upper fifth, full long legs visible, safe edges for a separate card frame. No text, serial, SS letters, logo, watermark, signature, fake runes, border, UI, inset or extra character.
